label: Offsite planner that asks before it plans
description: A chat agent that asks three or four multiple-choice questions with the Ask User Question tool before it plans a team offsite. The run pauses until the user answers.

triggers.description: Starts a run each time a user sends a message in the chat. It provides the message text and the conversation ID.
triggers.name: chat_1
triggers.label: New Chat Request

tasks.description: The offsite planner agent. Before it plans anything, it uses the Ask User Question tool to ask three or four multiple-choice questions; the run pauses until the user answers. Then it writes the plan.
tasks.name: aiAgent_1

parameters.systemPrompt: You plan team events. Never guess requirements. Before you plan anything, call the AskUserQuestionTool once with three or four multiple-choice questions covering budget, dates, team size and location. Offer 3 or 4 concrete options per question. After the answers arrive, produce a one-page plan.

model.description: The Claude model the planner reasons with. It chooses the questions to ask and writes the final plan. Needs an Anthropic connection.
model.name: anthropic_1

chatMemory.description: Keeps the conversation history per chat conversation ID, so the planner remembers the user's answers in later turns.
chatMemory.name: chatMemory_1

tools.description: Lets the agent show the user multiple-choice questions in the chat. The run pauses until the user answers, and the answers go back to the agent.
tools.name: aiAgentUtils_1

tasks.label: AI Agent

tasks.description: Sends the planner's reply, or the finished plan, back to the user in the chat.
tasks.name: reply_1
tasks.label: Reply
